additional_info.subject: RE: ID0474250-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370023] Logs Check CRM:00263000392
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out as I am taking over ticket
ID0474250.
I analyzed the logs for both chargers, and here are my findings:
Charger
313508370023
:
​​​​​​​Vehicle connected first time at 2026-01-24T16:40:52 and was authenticated.
Charger entered P03_CableCheck
Charger commanded to close OutgoingCoil QA13-14, but received no feedback.
It seems to me the outgoingcoil itself is not physically properly closing, or it is even stuck in a closed position.
Session fails as consequence
At 2026-01-24T17:11:51 a second session is attempted. It fails for the same reason.
At 2026-01-24T17:16:06 a reboot is triggered.
After the reboot, a third attempt happened at 2026-01-24T17:26:42. It fails again for the same reason, therefore I assume that the reboot and the forced movement of contactors during reboot was not successful.
Charger
313508370017:
​​​​​​​
Vehicle connected at 2026-01-24T18:00:29 and was authenticated.
Charger entered P03_CableCheck
Charger commanded to close OutgoingCoil QA13-14, but received no feedback. It seems to me the outgoingcoil itself is not physically properly closing, or it is even stuck in a closed position. This is the same exact behavior as per the other charger.
I had a look on AWS and saw that this behavior happened several times in the past 2 weeks.
I will forward this ticket to our RC-IT regional colleagues, so that they can perform an onsite inspection and replace the faulty components.
​​​​​​​Thank you!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
